sprint: Sprint 8: Manifest Consolidation and PDF Wave B Publication Closure

preflight_check.note: XlsConverter absent because run 5 overwrote manifest with only run 5's candidates. Run 5 failed XlsConverter.

replay_validation_logic.behavior: Reads pr-candidate-manifest.json. Fails preflight if publishable_candidate_count == 0.
replay_validation_logic.current_issue: With old overwrite logic: if a run has 0 passing examples, the manifest shows publishable_candidate_count=0, blocking replay even if prior runs had passing candidates.
replay_validation_logic.fix_impact: With merge_existing=True: manifest accumulates candidates. publishable_candidate_count always reflects all accumulated passes across runs, not just current run.

post_fix_expected_state.note: After next run with merge_existing=True, XlsConverter from run 1 will be preserved via Rule 3 (prior pass preserved when new run fails same scenario). The manifest will also include currently-published scenarios (merger, splitter, text-extractor) which are still in included_examples since they're not excluded.

replay_integration_verdict: COMPATIBLE — The merge fix is additive-only. Replay validation check (publishable_candidate_count > 0) will still work: merged manifest always has count >= current run count. No replay stage changes required.
